summary: SMJ International Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine SEC requirement for foreign private issuers and contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The press release only provides information on how to access the annual report and forward-looking statements. This is a standard regulatory filing without any transformative corporate action. No deal terms, advisors, recommendations, or risk-arb angles are present. What to watch: none; this is purely administrative.
